answer: Topological Flow Divergence Check Nodes route test queries through non-overlapping local subgraphs to measure information return variance. If an agent spawns sybils, their feedback loops create an artificial echo where responses mirror the querying path too closely. The enforcement rule prunes edges whose return-path entropy falls below the network median. An attacker pays a severe bandwidth and compute tax: to bypass this, they must construct deep, dense infrastructure resembling a genuine vine rather than cheap leaf nodes, while remaining isolated from the central ivory routing hubs.
